35		minScore := fs.Int("min-score", 0, "Gate minimum bundle quality score (0-100)")
36		force := fs.Bool("force", false, "Reinstall existing vendor bundles")
37		fs.Usage = printRestoreUsage

40			os.Exit(2)
41		}
42	
43		if *minScore < 0 || *minScore > 100 {

45			exitFunc(2)

58	func runRestore(registryURL string, force bool, minScores ...int) {
59		minScore := 0
60		if len(minScores) > 0 {
61			minScore = minScores[0]
62		}
63	
64		lf, err := lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")

68			return

70	
71		if lf == nil || len(lf.Bundles) == 0 {
72			fmt.Println("No vendor bundles specified in okf.lock.")
73			return
74		}
75	
76		client := newRegistryClient(registryURL)
77		restoredCount := 0
78		skippedCount := 0
79	
80		for _, entry := range lf.Bundles {
81			// okf.lock may come from a repository: its ids must resolve inside
82			// .okf/vendor before anything is installed there or rolled back from there.
83			vendorDisplay := filepath.Join(".okf", "vendor", filepath.FromSlash(entry.ID))
84			vendorDir, err := registry.ResolveVendorDir(".", entry.ID)
85			if err != nil {

88				return
89			}
90			indexFile := filepath.Join(vendorDir, "index.md")
91	
92			if _, err := os.Stat(indexFile); err == nil && !force {
93				fmt.Printf("Bundle %q is already installed in %s (skipping)\n", entry.ID, vendorDisplay)
94				skippedCount++
95				continue
96			}
97	
98			source := entry.Source
99			if source == "" {
100				source = entry.ID
101			}
102			if entry.Version != "" && !strings.Contains(source, "@") && entry.Version != "main" {
103				source = fmt.Sprintf("%s@%s", source, entry.Version)
104			}
105	
106			fmt.Printf("Resolving %s from %s...\n", entry.ID, client.BaseURL)
107			manifest, err := client.Resolve(source)
108			if err != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error resolving %s: %v\n", entry.ID, err)
110				exitFunc(1)
111				return
112			}
113	
114			if entry.Hash != "" {
115				manifest.Hash = entry.Hash
116			}
117	
118			fmt.Printf("Downloading %s (version: %s)...\n", manifest.ID, manifest.Version)
119			// Extract and validate in a fresh staging directory: rollback discards
120			// only what this invocation created, never an existing directory.
121			staging, err := registry.NewStaging(".")
122			if err != nil {
123				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: refusing to restore %s: %v\n", entry.ID, err)
124				exitFunc(1)
125				return
126			}
127			if err := client.DownloadAndExtract(manifest, staging.Dir); err != nil {
128				_ = staging.Discard()
129				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Download error for %s: %v\n", manifest.ID, err)
130				exitFunc(1)
131				return
132			}
133	
134			rollback := func() {
135				if err := staging.Discard(); err != nil {
136					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: rollback refused: %v\n", err)
137				}
138			}
139	
140			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(staging.Dir, "index.md")); os.IsNotExist(err) {
141				rollback()
